items.title: Customizing Privacy and Security Settings for Online Platforms (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Customizing Privacy and Security Settings for Online Platforms (PDF 125, printed 121).

blocks.text: Zyada tar online platforms users ko apni marzi (comfort level) ke mutabiq privacy aur security settings badalne dete hain. Yeh settings control karti hain ke aap ki posts kaun dekhe, aap se kaun rabta kare aur data kaise use ho. Two-factor authentication on karna aur apps ki permissions mehdood karna safety barhata hai. User ko apni settings baqaida dekhni aur update karni chahiyein kyunke platforms aksar apne privacy rules badalte hain. Yeh options apne mutabiq banane se user ko apni digital maujoodgi aur hifazat par zyada control milta hai. Misal: WhatsApp par user chun sakta hai ke us ki profile photo kaun dekhe: everyone (sab), only contacts (sirf contacts) ya nobody (koi nahi). Woh read receipts bhi band kar sakta hai, jinhein aam taur par blue ticks kehte hain, ta ke doosre na dekh sakein ke un ke messages parh liye gaye hain ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: WhatsApp par privacy ke liye kitab kaun si do settings batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Profile photo kaun dekhe (everyone, sirf contacts ya nobody), aur read receipts (blue ticks) band karna taake doosre na dekh sakein ke message parh liya gaya.

items: Platforms par settings apni marzi ke mutabiq: kaun posts dekhe, kaun rabta kare, data kaise use ho.
2FA on karein, app permissions mehdood rakhein, settings baqaida dekhein.
